title: Beautiful Move Alert: Finish the Promotion Plan
summary: After diverting the bishop, promote and keep calculating: checks and captures convert the queen advantage into exact winning checkpoints.

nodes.question: What remains to verify once the pawn can promote?
nodes.explanation: e8=Q is available, but Black still has a bishop and four pawns. The complete eight-piece diagram requires a finite proof before reducing to exact seven-piece positions.

branches.title: Independent king reply: collect a pawn with check
commentary: Begin at the final promotion opportunity; the earlier knight and a-pawn sacrifices have already happened and are outside this selected proof.
e8=Q promotes without check. All four black pawns and the bishop remain, so this is still an eight-piece position.
Kc4 is an independently supplied king reply. It leaves c6 available to the new queen.
Qxc6+ captures c6 and checks c4 along the c-file. The complete seven-piece ending retains Bb4/d5/g6/h5 and is an exact White win.

branches.title: Independent bishop reply: capture with check
commentary: Compare the bishop’s retreat after the same source promotion, retaining every pawn.
e8=Q creates the queen while Black still has eighteen legal replies. The proof enumerates all of them.
Bd6 moves the bishop onto the sixth rank, where it can interpose on some queen checks but cannot protect every pawn.
Qxg6+ removes the g6 pawn and checks Kd3 along g6–f5–e4–d3. The resulting seven-piece position is an exact White win; the bishop on d6 remains.

branches.title: Independent bishop reply: take the offered bishop
commentary: Compare a bishop move onto the queen’s file. This legal representative reply is independent analysis.
e8=Q begins the verified later conversion rather than certifying the earlier larger composition.
Be1 leaves the bishop on the e-file, which is clear between the new queen and e1.
Qxe1 removes the bishop. White Kh1/Qe1 faces Kd3/c6/d5/g6/h5: seven pieces and an exact White win, without silently deleting any pawn.

exercises.prompt: Why is promotion not itself a seven-piece tablebase position?
exercises.answer: Replacing the pawn with a queen does not change the number of pieces. Kh1/Qe8 and Kd3/Bb4/c6/d5/g6/h5 total eight.

exercises.prompt: What does the proof add beyond the narrated promotion?
exercises.answer: It checks every Black reply and supplies a legal White continuation into exact supported wins. The earlier knight interference and sacrifices still require their own larger-position proof.
